lines.text: Spell-checkers, search boxes and password rules all process text one character at a time. Let’s learn how.
Text is a string of characters, each with a position. letter (1) of [apple] is a; length of [apple] is 5.
Same pattern as lists: i from 1 to the length, read letter i each time.
Start with an empty string and join letters onto it.
Joining each letter to the FRONT reverses the word.
A palindrome reads the same backwards: level, racecar, noon.
Reverse the word and compare it with the original.
In Python, a for loop can walk through the characters of a string, just like our Scratch loop.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
